findings.claim: The words 'world' (dunya) and 'hereafter' (akhira) each occur 115 times in the Quran.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: Our substring recount on the Tanzil Uthmani text: دنيا 115, اخرة 115 — exact match.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)
source.title: Miracles of the Qur'an — 'Word Repetitions in the Qur'an'

findings.claim: The words 'paradise' (jannah) and 'hell' (jahannam) each occur 77 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: Strict singular forms (الجنة/جنة with prefixes: الجنة 56 + جنة 18 + وجنة 2 + بالجنة 1) = 77; جهنم substring 77. The جنة substring alone is 78 — the one extra token is أَجِنَّةٌ (ajinnah, 'fetuses', 53:32), not a form of 'garden' (an earlier draft of this note called it a construct form). The popular 77/77 claim counts singular 'garden' only. Counting every garden by root/lemma (QAC lemma jan~ap: singular 71 + plural جنات 69 + dual 7) gives 147 — that is the 147 in Agent 1's heaven/hell pair (147:77), while hell (jahannam) is 77 under both rules. Both numbers are true under different stated rules: singular garden vs all gardens.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)
source.title: Miracles of the Qur'an — 'Word Repetitions in the Qur'an'

findings.claim: The words 'devil' (shaytan) and 'angel' each occur 88 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: Devils: شيط 70 + شياطين 18 = 88. Angels: QAC lemma malak = 88 — plural ملائكة 73 + 13 singular + 2 duals (الملكين 2:102, ملكين 7:20). The singulars: 6:8 ×2 (ملك and ملكا — two tokens in one verse), 6:9, 6:50, 11:12, 11:31, 12:31, 17:95, 25:7, 32:11 (ملك الموت, Angel of Death), 53:26, 69:17, 89:22. Our earlier note counted only 12 non-plural forms (missing the second 6:8 token, the 7:20 dual and 17:95) and so stopped three short at about 85. The pair 88:88 is confirmed. Note: the bare surface form ملك/الملك totals 63 and mostly means 'king/sovereignty' — sense disambiguation is required, which the lemma count provides.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)
source.title: Miracles of the Qur'an — 'Word Repetitions in the Qur'an'

findings.claim: The word 'day' (yawm) occurs 365 times, matching the days of a (Gregorian) year.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source; our recount reproduces 365 only under a stated selective method (see note).
findings.our_note: Simple forms يوم/اليوم/يوما = 274; plus prefixed ويوم 44, واليوم 23, ليوم 8, فاليوم 8, بيوم 5, باليوم 2, وباليوم 1 = 365 exactly. Caveat: suffixed forms (يومكم, يومهم, يومئذ 65+), dual يومين and plural أيام are excluded by this method; all tokens containing يوم = 590, polluted by belief verbs (يؤمنون). The Islamic calendar has 354/355 days, so the Gregorian-365 framing is itself a critique point (WikiIslam).

findings.claim: The word 'month' (shahr) occurs 12 times, matching the months of a year.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source; our recount reproduces 12 only under a stated selective method (see note).
findings.our_note: Simple شهر/الشهر/شهرا = 10; plus بالشهر 1, والشهر 1 = 12 exactly. Dual شهرين (2) and plural أشهر (5) + الأشهر (1) are excluded by this method.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)

findings.claim: The word for the (five daily) prayers (salawat) occurs 5 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: 7 tokens match صلوات, at 2:157, 2:238, 9:99, 9:103, 11:87, 22:40, 23:9. The 5 plural صلوات are 2:157, 2:238, 9:99, 22:40, 23:9; 9:103 and 11:87 are singular صلاة written صلوة in Uthmani. Only 3 of the 5 mean 'prayers' (2:157 = blessings, 22:40 = synagogues) — WikiIslam's sense critique.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)
source.title: Miracles of the Qur'an — 'Word Repetitions in the Qur'an'

findings.claim: The word 'sea' occurs 32 times and 'land' 13 times (the ratio 13/45 = 29% land, 71% sea, matching the Earth's surface).
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: Sea: البحر 23 + والبحر 9 = 32 confirmed (all بحر tokens 40, incl. dual البحرين 4). Land: the البر-form total is 21 (البر 19 + prefixed forms), mixing 'land' and 'righteousness/piety' senses (e.g. 2:177); the figure 13 requires sense disambiguation we did not perform, so the pair as stated cannot be verified. The 29:71 land/sea ratio claim therefore cannot be verified as stated.

source.author: Harun Yahya (Adnan Oktar)
source.title: Miracles of the Qur'an — 'Word Repetitions in the Qur'an'

findings.claim: The words 'man' and 'woman' (singular) each occur 24 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source. (Note: Harun Yahya's published list gives 23/23; the 24/24 figure is from the circulating Al-Suwaidan/Elias list.)
findings.our_note: Man singular (رجل family): رجل 13 + رجلا 7 + لرجل 2 + فرجل 1 + ورجلا 1 = 24. Woman singular (امرأة family): امرات 6 + امراتهو 5 + امراة 3 + وامراتهو 2 + امراتك 2 + امراتى 2 + وامراتى 1 + لامراتهي 1 + وامراة 1 + وامرات 1 = 24. (An earlier draft of this note mislabelled the -hu/-hi suffixes as امراتهي/لامراتهو — corrected here.) Harun Yahya's own list gives 23/23 — one short on each side — so the 24/24 figure belongs to the circulating Al-Suwaidan/Elias list, not to Yahya. With duals (plurals excluded): man 30, woman 26; with plurals (رجال 27, نساء 59) the root totals are 57/85. Naive substrings: رجل 45, امرا 46 — the امرا count includes امرأ 'man' 19 and the extra token سَامِرًا (23:67, 'chatting by night'), not السامري as an earlier draft said (السامري contains no امرا substring).

source.author: Tariq Al-Suwaidan (circulating list; also Mufti Afzal Hoosen Elias, 'Astonishing Facts about the Qur'aan')

findings.claim: The words 'life' (hayat) and 'death' (mawt) each occur 145 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source. (Note: Harun Yahya's published list does not include this pair; it circulates on other sites, e.g. quranic-miracles.com.)
findings.our_note: حياة family (حيو/حيي/حيا) = 125; الحياة noun = 67. موت family = 171 (موت/ميت/مات, after removing the 23 ظلم-forms (الظلمات 14 + ظلمات 8 + كظلمات 1) and 14 كلمات-forms false positives caught by the مات substring — an earlier draft of this note said 22 ظلم-forms, omitting كظلمات); الموت noun = 35; موت substring = 91. No straightforward form/root count reproduces 145/145. This pair is not in Harun Yahya's published list; it circulates on other sites.

source.author: Circulating list (quranic-miracles.com; Tariq Al-Suwaidan; Mufti Afzal Hoosen Elias)
source.title: 'Word repetitions' — circulating mathematical-miracle list

findings.claim: Harun Yahya pairs 'sun' (shams) and 'light' (nur), each 33 times, counting simple forms only; separately, 'moon' (qamar) occurs 27 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Yahya's rule for sun/light: 'only the simple forms of the word were included'. Moon 27 is a separate widely-circulated claim (WikiIslam), not paired with sun by Yahya — Yahya's page contains no 'moon' at all.
findings.our_note: Sun: شمس substring 33 exact. Moon: قمر substring 27 exact. Light: نور substring 46; lemma nuwr 43; the claimed 33 is reproduced only by a narrow selection of simple forms — نور 8 + النور 10 + نورا 9 + والنور 3 + بنور 1 + نورهم 2 = 33 — excluding نورنا/نوركم and منير ('shining') forms. So the sun+light 33/33 pair is confirmed under that stated selection, and moon 27 stands on its own. An earlier draft of this finding conflated the two claims into one sun/moon pair.

findings.claim: The words 'reward' (al-jaza') and 'forgiveness' (maghfira) occur 117 and 234 times (forgiveness exactly double reward).
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: The filed Arabic ثواب (thawab) was wrong — Yahya's word is الجزاء (al-jaza'), and the thawab substring is only 13. By root: QAC root j-z-y = 118 — one more than the claimed 117, so the reward side needs an unstated one-token exclusion. Forgiveness reproduces exactly as the QAC root gh-f-r = 234 (including غفور, يغفر, استغفار and مغفرة forms). So the pair as claimed differs by one on the reward side only. (مغفر substring alone is 28 — that counts only the مغفر- stem, not the whole root.)

findings.claim: The words 'wine' (khamr) and 'intoxication' (sakara) each occur 6 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: خمر substring 7 (claimed 6); سكر substring 4 (claimed 6). The سكر family totals 7: the 4 are سكرت (15:15), سكرتهم (15:72), سكرا (16:67) and سكرة (50:19) — سكرة was already inside the 4, so it cannot be added again — plus سكارى, 3 tokens (4:43 ×1, 22:2 ×2, the verse containing it twice). An earlier draft of this note added سكرة on top of the 4 and counted سكارى as 2 — two compensating errors; the family total 7 is right either way. The two sides do not match as claimed (7 vs 7 by root would match, but the claimed figure is 6/6).

findings.claim: The word 'human being' (insan) occurs 65 times.
findings.corpus_and_method: Method not stated by the source.
findings.our_note: انسان substring = 65 exactly. The creation-stage reading (the stages of human creation summing to 65) does not reproduce: تراب 20 + نطفة 12 + علقة 6 + مضغة 3 + عظام 13 + لحم 58 = 112 by substring. (An earlier draft of this note gave علقة as 7 — the 7th is the bare word علق in 96:2, which has no ة; علقة itself is 6: علقة 4 + العلقة 1 + كالمعلقة 1.) Yahya's own stage table gives different numbers again (soil 17, drop 12, embryo 6, lump 3, bone 15, flesh 12 = 65) — his stages are a different selection from the substring counts, so the 65 total for 'human being' is confirmed but the stage arithmetic is not.

findings.our_note: Our 325,386 (excl. unnumbered basmalahs) matches none of the classical figures exactly; the classical sources disagree among themselves by up to 7,718 (323,015 vs 330,733), and further variants exist (Mujahid 321,000; Ibn Mas'ud 300,670; Salam Abu Muhammad 340,740), so no single letter total is settled. meta.corpus: Tanzil Quran Text, Uthmani script (corpus/quran-uthmani.txt), 6,236 verses, downloaded 2026-11-06 from tanzil.net
meta.project: miracleMath — scholar findings on the Quran corpus
meta.recount_method: Whitespace tokens. Skeleton normalisation for matching: diacritics/tatweel removed; hamza variants normalised (أ إ آ ٱ → ا, ؤ → و, ئ → ي, ء dropped); dagger alif ٰ → ا, small waw ۥ → و, small yeh ۦ → ي are kept as letters for matching. Letter-counting convention: base letters count, including alef wasla ٱ as ا; dagger alif, small waw and small yeh are marks and do NOT count; standalone hamza ء counts. This convention reproduces the anchors: basmalah = 19 letters, 96:1-5 = 76 letters, 110:1 = 19 letters. 'Excl. unnumbered basmalahs' means excluding the 112 basmalahs merged into verse 1 of surahs 2-8 and 10-114 (the 2 numbered basmalahs, 1:1 and 27:30, are kept). Surah boundaries use the standard Hafs verse-count table (sums to 6,236).
meta.warning: Disputed numerology is presented here as reported findings with a source and a status — never as settled fact. our_status 'confirmed' means our own scripted recount on the Tanzil file reproduces the claimed figure under a stated method; 'differs' means it does not; 'cannot_verify' means no recount was possible or the claim needs sense disambiguation.
meta.reconciled: 2026-11-07: scholar-vs-recount reconciliation (Checker A re-counted our numbers; Checker B verified every scholar claim against its source). Tallies now confirmed 28 / differs 25 / cannot_verify 11; our_status and confidence agree on all 64 findings. See RECONCILIATION.md.
